name: EZ Bar Wide-Grip Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold an EZ bar in front of your thighs using an underhand grip on the wide outer angled sections.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides and brace your core firmly.
Curl the bar upward toward your chest without letting your elbows drift forward.
Pause briefly at the top contraction, then lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid swaying backward to heave the bar up.
Keep your wrists in line with your forearms as you lower the bar.
